description: This file is a shell script used for setting up and testing Icelandic locale configurations within the Git project. It sources other shell libraries, detects available locales, and manages environment variables related to gettext internationalization.

methods.name: test-have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a prerequisite, such as gettext.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Marks a prerequisite as satisfied for testing purposes.
